methodologyNotes: Each plan was independently verified by fetching the provider's own pricing page on 2026-06-13. A provider is retained only where its plan lineup, storage limits and prices could be confirmed on the live page (USD directly, or — for pages that geolocated to EUR — the same lineup and storage confirmed on-page with the matching US USD figures corroborated by multiple independent 2026 pricing references). Providers whose live page no longer matched the recorded structure, rendered no confirmable prices, or showed only non-USD lifetime figures were dropped rather than kept on a guess. Consumer plans are flat per-account per month in USD; team/business tiers that bill per user carry the per-user USD price with billingModel per_seat, and quote-only tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. HIPAA/BAA do not apply to consumer cloud storage and are null, annualDiscountPct is recorded only where the provider publishes an annual rate, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier. Dropped on 2026-06-13: google-one (live plans page now shows AI-bundled tiers, not the storage-only 2/10/20/30 TB lineup, and third-party sources contradict each other); pcloud (live page rendered only EUR lifetime prices, no confirmable USD subscription price); box (live pricing page renders no prices client-side and corroboration sources disagree on the lineup).

vendors.name: Dropbox
vendors.provenance: https://www.dropbox.com/plans (official plans page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page geolocated to EUR and confirmed the Basic/Plus/Professional/Standard/Advanced lineup with matching storage, so the US USD prices and the Family tier were corroborated via Cloudwards, Vendr and Neowin 2026 references)

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free tier with 2 GB of storage for a single user and up to three linked devices.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 1 user, 2 TB storage, file transfers up to 50 GB, PDF editing and signature tools; $9.99/mo ($119.88/yr) when billed annually.

plans.name: Professional / Essentials
plans.notes: 1 user, 3 TB storage, 180-day file restore, transfers up to 100 GB, branded sharing and password-protected files; $16.58/mo ($199/yr) when billed annually.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 users sharing 2 TB of storage, billed as one flat household plan; $16.99/mo ($203.88/yr) when billed annually.

plans.name: Standard (Business)
plans.notes: Per-user team plan, minimum 3 users; $18/user/mo billed monthly or $15/user/mo ($180/yr per user) billed annually, 5 TB shared team storage with admin controls.

plans.name: Advanced (Business)
plans.notes: Per-user team plan, minimum 3 users; $30/user/mo billed monthly or $24/user/mo ($288/yr per user) billed annually, 15 TB+ team storage, 1-year file restore, SSO and advanced security.

limits: Basic free tier limited to 2 GB storage and 3 linked devices
Version history: 30 days on Basic/Plus, 180 days on Standard/Professional, 1 year on Advanced
File transfer limits: 50 GB on Plus, 100 GB on Professional/Standard/Advanced, 250 GB on Enterprise
HIPAA compliance (signed BAA) available on Dropbox business team plans — Standard, Advanced, Enterprise and Education — not on Basic, Plus, Professional or Family
keyFeatures: 256-bit AES encryption at rest, SSL/TLS in transit
Dropbox Rewind (point-in-time folder restore)
Password-protected and expiring shared links
PDF editing and e-signature tools
Ransomware detection and breach alerts
Dark web monitoring
SOC 1, 2, and 3 compliance reports available
bestFor: Teams needing secure file collaboration with granular permissions
Freelancers and professionals wanting large file transfers
Businesses requiring HIPAA compliance via a signed BAA on Dropbox business team plans (Standard and above)
Users already working within Microsoft or Google productivity suites
enrichment.provenance: Compliance facts sourced from dropbox.com/security (SOC 1/2/3, HIPAA, GDPR confirmed). HIPAA availability on Advanced plan confirmed from dropbox.com/plans feature comparison table. Features from dropbox.com/features.

vendors.name: Microsoft OneDrive (Microsoft 365)
vendors.provenance: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/onedrive/compare-onedrive-plans (official US OneDrive/Microsoft 365 plan comparison page; all four tiers, USD + annual prices, and per-plan storage re-verified live 2026-06-23). The listed integrations are first-party to the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Office apps, Teams, Outlook, Copilot, native Windows File Explorer sync), which is OneDrive's core value over standalone storage.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 (Free)
plans.notes: 5 GB of OneDrive storage plus web and mobile versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and other apps.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Basic
plans.notes: 100 GB OneDrive storage, ad-free Outlook email, calendar and contacts for one person; $19.99/year if billed annually.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Personal
plans.notes: 1 TB OneDrive storage for one person, desktop Office apps with Microsoft Copilot, Defender and Teams; $99.99/year if billed annually.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Family
plans.notes: 6 TB total OneDrive storage (1 TB per person for up to 6 people) with desktop Office apps; $129.99/year if billed annually.

limits: Free tier limited to 5 GB OneDrive storage
HIPAA BAA available for Office 365 Commercial and GCC environments; requires enterprise agreement
Personal/Family plans are consumer tiers — HIPAA BAA applies to business/enterprise Office 365 subscriptions, not personal consumer plans
File size limit: 250 GB per file for OneDrive
Version history: 30 days on all consumer plans
keyFeatures: Real-time co-authoring in Word, Excel, PowerPoint directly from OneDrive
Personal Vault with multi-factor authentication for sensitive files
Ransomware detection and recovery tools
Password-protected and expiring sharing links
Microsoft Copilot AI integration (Personal and Family plans)
Automatic photo backup from mobile devices
Offline file access and sync across Windows, Mac, iOS, Android
End-to-end encryption and encryption at rest
bestFor: Microsoft 365 subscribers wanting tightly integrated document collaboration
Windows users seeking automatic PC folder backup (Desktop, Documents, Pictures)
Families wanting up to 6 TB split across 6 members
Enterprises and healthcare organizations needing HIPAA BAA (via Office 365 business plans)
enrichment.provenance: HIPAA BAA and SOC 2 audit scope cover OneDrive for Business under Office 365 Commercial (learn.microsoft.com), which is a separate business product — none of the consumer plans listed here (Microsoft 365 Free/Basic/Personal/Family) are covered by a BAA or the OneDrive for Business SOC 2 report, so hipaa and soc2 are false for this consumer lineup. GDPR applies to all Microsoft consumer and business services via the Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum, so gdpr is true. Features from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/onedrive/online-cloud-storage.
